about: A brainstorm that grows one idea at a time. A slide once there is a real list is good; redrawing the slide on every new bullet, or captioning every update, is churn.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Let's brainstorm ways to cut onboarding drop-off.

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: A progress bar so people know how many steps are left.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: And a skip button for the profile step.

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: Oh, maybe also a welcome email.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Okay, let's vote on these async.
